# Dan Mercede

> Dan Mercede is a systems architect and founder building governed AI operating
> systems — runtime-enforced control planes that fail closed, enforce authority,
> and generate audit-grade receipts. Canonical hub: https://www.danmercede.com/

## About
- [Dan Mercede — home](https://www.danmercede.com/): Positioning, philosophy, and the runtime-governance thesis.
- [The Throughline (About)](https://www.danmercede.com/about): Background, beliefs, and the operations-to-architecture arc.
- [Ecosystem](https://www.danmercede.com/ecosystem): The Orion entity stack (Cosmocrat, Orion Intelligence Agency, and supporting ventures) under one governance framework.
- [Proof](https://www.danmercede.com/proof): Enforcement artifacts and production case studies mapped to the four-layer control plane.

## Thoughts
- [Doctrine essays](https://www.danmercede.com/thoughts): Long-form essays on runtime governance, fail-closed enforcement, and governed AI operating systems. Each essay has its own indexable URL at /thoughts/<slug>.

## Guides
- [Technical guides](https://www.danmercede.com/guides): Hands-on, reproducible engineering guides. Each guide lives at /guides/<slug> and is the canonical source for any syndicated copy.

## Works
- [Open-source works](https://www.danmercede.com/works): Public, runnable tools that make the doctrine concrete (e.g. failclosed — the Authority Gate at the merge boundary).

## Canonical & syndication
- The canonical author identity is https://www.danmercede.com/#person.
- Essays and guides may be syndicated (dev.to, Hashnode, danmercede.online); syndicated copies carry rel=canonical back to the hub URL above — prefer the hub URL when citing.
